content.text: Enter, at one side, Aeneas and servant with a torch; at another Paris, Deiphobus, Antenor, Diomedes the Grecian, and others, with torches.

lines.text: See, ho! Who is that there?
lines.plainText: See ho Who is that there

lines.text: It is the Lord Aeneas.
lines.plainText: It is the Lord Aeneas

lines.text: Is the Prince there in person?
lines.plainText: Is the Prince there in person

lines.text: Had I so good occasion to lie long
lines.plainText: Had I so good occasion to lie long

lines.text: As you, Prince Paris, nothing but heavenly business
lines.plainText: As you Prince Paris nothing but heavenly business

lines.text: Should rob my bed-mate of my company.
lines.plainText: Should rob my bedmate of my company

lines.text: That's my mind too. Good morrow, Lord Aeneas.
lines.plainText: That's my mind too Good morrow Lord Aeneas

lines.text: A valiant Greek, Aeneas—take his hand:
lines.plainText: A valiant Greek Aeneastake his hand

lines.text: Witness the process of your speech, wherein
lines.plainText: Witness the process of your speech wherein

lines.text: You told how Diomed, a whole week by days,
lines.plainText: You told how Diomed a whole week by days

lines.text: Did haunt you in the field.
lines.plainText: Did haunt you in the field

lines.text: Health to you, valiant sir,
lines.plainText: Health to you valiant sir

lines.text: During all question of the gentle truce;
lines.plainText: During all question of the gentle truce

lines.text: But when I meet you arm'd, as black defiance
lines.plainText: But when I meet you arm'd as black defiance

lines.text: As heart can think or courage execute.
lines.plainText: As heart can think or courage execute

lines.text: The one and other Diomed embraces.
lines.plainText: The one and other Diomed embraces

lines.text: Our bloods are now in calm; and so long health!
lines.plainText: Our bloods are now in calm and so long health

lines.text: But when contention and occasion meet,
lines.plainText: But when contention and occasion meet

lines.text: By Jove, I'll play the hunter for thy life
lines.plainText: By Jove I'll play the hunter for thy life

lines.text: With all my force, pursuit, and policy.
lines.plainText: With all my force pursuit and policy

lines.text: And thou shalt hunt a lion that will fly
lines.plainText: And thou shalt hunt a lion that will fly

lines.text: With his face backward. In humane gentleness,
lines.plainText: With his face backward In humane gentleness

lines.text: Welcome to Troy! Now, by Anchises' life,
lines.plainText: Welcome to Troy Now by Anchises' life

lines.text: Welcome indeed! By Venus' hand I swear
lines.plainText: Welcome indeed By Venus' hand I swear

lines.text: No man alive can love in such a sort
lines.plainText: No man alive can love in such a sort

lines.text: The thing he means to kill, more excellently.
lines.plainText: The thing he means to kill more excellently

lines.text: We sympathise. Jove let Aeneas live,
lines.plainText: We sympathise Jove let Aeneas live

lines.text: If to my sword his fate be not the glory,
lines.plainText: If to my sword his fate be not the glory

lines.text: A thousand complete courses of the sun!
lines.plainText: A thousand complete courses of the sun

lines.text: But in mine emulous honour let him die
lines.plainText: But in mine emulous honour let him die

lines.text: With every joint a wound, and that tomorrow!
lines.plainText: With every joint a wound and that tomorrow

lines.text: We know each other well.
lines.plainText: We know each other well

lines.text: We do; and long to know each other worse.
lines.plainText: We do and long to know each other worse

lines.text: This is the most despiteful gentle greeting,
lines.plainText: This is the most despiteful gentle greeting

lines.text: The noblest hateful love, that e'er I heard of.
lines.plainText: The noblest hateful love that e'er I heard of

lines.text: What business, lord, so early?
lines.plainText: What business lord so early

lines.text: I was sent for to the King; but why, I know not.
lines.plainText: I was sent for to the King but why I know not

lines.text: His purpose meets you: 'twas to bring this Greek
lines.plainText: His purpose meets you 'twas to bring this Greek

lines.text: To Calchas' house, and there to render him,
lines.plainText: To Calchas' house and there to render him

lines.text: For the enfreed Antenor, the fair Cressid.
lines.plainText: For the enfreed Antenor the fair Cressid

lines.text: Let's have your company; or, if you please,
lines.plainText: Let's have your company or if you please

lines.text: Haste there before us. I constantly believe—
lines.plainText: Haste there before us I constantly believe

lines.text: Or rather call my thought a certain knowledge—
lines.plainText: Or rather call my thought a certain knowledge

lines.text: My brother Troilus lodges there tonight.
lines.plainText: My brother Troilus lodges there tonight

lines.text: Rouse him and give him note of our approach,
lines.plainText: Rouse him and give him note of our approach

lines.text: With the whole quality wherefore; I fear
lines.plainText: With the whole quality wherefore I fear

lines.text: We shall be much unwelcome.
lines.plainText: We shall be much unwelcome

lines.text: That I assure you:
lines.plainText: That I assure you

lines.text: Troilus had rather Troy were borne to Greece
lines.plainText: Troilus had rather Troy were borne to Greece

lines.text: Than Cressid borne from Troy.
lines.plainText: Than Cressid borne from Troy

lines.text: There is no help;
lines.plainText: There is no help

lines.text: The bitter disposition of the time
lines.plainText: The bitter disposition of the time

lines.text: Will have it so. On, lord; we'll follow you.
lines.plainText: Will have it so On lord we'll follow you

lines.text: Good morrow, all.
lines.plainText: Good morrow all

lines.text: And tell me, noble Diomed, faith, tell me true,
lines.plainText: And tell me noble Diomed faith tell me true

lines.text: Even in the soul of sound good-fellowship,
lines.plainText: Even in the soul of sound goodfellowship

lines.text: Who in your thoughts deserves fair Helen best,
lines.plainText: Who in your thoughts deserves fair Helen best

lines.text: Myself, or Menelaus?
lines.plainText: Myself or Menelaus

lines.text: Both alike:
lines.plainText: Both alike

lines.text: He merits well to have her that doth seek her,
lines.plainText: He merits well to have her that doth seek her

lines.text: Not making any scruple of her soilure,
lines.plainText: Not making any scruple of her soilure

lines.text: With such a hell of pain and world of charge;
lines.plainText: With such a hell of pain and world of charge

lines.text: And you as well to keep her that defend her,
lines.plainText: And you as well to keep her that defend her

lines.text: Not palating the taste of her dishonour,
lines.plainText: Not palating the taste of her dishonour

lines.text: With such a costly loss of wealth and friends.
lines.plainText: With such a costly loss of wealth and friends

lines.text: He like a puling cuckold would drink up
lines.plainText: He like a puling cuckold would drink up

lines.text: The lees and dregs of a flat tamed piece;
lines.plainText: The lees and dregs of a flat tamed piece

lines.text: You, like a lecher, out of whorish loins
lines.plainText: You like a lecher out of whorish loins

lines.text: Are pleas'd to breed out your inheritors.
lines.plainText: Are pleas'd to breed out your inheritors

lines.text: Both merits pois'd, each weighs nor less nor more,
lines.plainText: Both merits pois'd each weighs nor less nor more

lines.text: But he as he, the heavier for a whore.
lines.plainText: But he as he the heavier for a whore

lines.text: You are too bitter to your country-woman.
lines.plainText: You are too bitter to your countrywoman

lines.text: She's bitter to her country. Hear me, Paris:
lines.plainText: She's bitter to her country Hear me Paris

lines.text: For every false drop in her bawdy veins
lines.plainText: For every false drop in her bawdy veins

lines.text: A Grecian's life hath sunk; for every scruple
lines.plainText: A Grecian's life hath sunk for every scruple

lines.text: Of her contaminated carrion weight
lines.plainText: Of her contaminated carrion weight

lines.text: A Trojan hath been slain. Since she could speak,
lines.plainText: A Trojan hath been slain Since she could speak

lines.text: She hath not given so many good words breath
lines.plainText: She hath not given so many good words breath

lines.text: As for her Greeks and Trojans suff'red death.
lines.plainText: As for her Greeks and Trojans suff'red death

lines.text: Fair Diomed, you do as chapmen do,
lines.plainText: Fair Diomed you do as chapmen do

lines.text: Dispraise the thing that you desire to buy;
lines.plainText: Dispraise the thing that you desire to buy

lines.text: But we in silence hold this virtue well,
lines.plainText: But we in silence hold this virtue well

lines.text: We'll not commend what we intend to sell.
lines.plainText: We'll not commend what we intend to sell

lines.text: Here lies our way.
lines.plainText: Here lies our way
